thesis: Disciplined uncertainty proportionally accepts evidence, separates compatibility from confirmation, and corrects local errors without identity defense.

ideas.statement: A claim supports a hypothesis comparatively only when expected differently under alternatives; absent predicted detectable traces can matter, and every claim type needs its proper source.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: No numerical probability of God is assigned; tools can verify inference or aid provenance but cannot replace checking premises and documents.
